authority.owner_spec: Juniper 1 Design Specification v0.7 — Four Destination Backup (2026-10-09)

tokenizer.proposed: j1tok-24k (clean-sample candidate v5, frozen record cand5-j1tok-24k)
tokenizer.layout: IDs 0-63 control (12 named, 52 reserved), 64-319 byte fallback, then learned
tokenizer.status: PROVISIONAL (all candidates within the 0.5 % tie band; short single-scale pilots)

data_and_tokens.initial_target_and_ceiling: ≈3B initial (met at ≈3.44B unique tokens); 15B ceiling is not a target
data_and_tokens.stages: base pretraining only in this contract; continuation/distillation/SFT/refinement are separate, later, explicitly allocated stages

selection.reason: an alternative clears the band on only one comparison; core retained provisionally

architecture.qk_norm: learnable RMSNorm over head_dim, one weight per layer for queries and one for keys (shared across heads), before RoPE

optimization.optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.1 on 2-D matrices only, clip 1.0
optimization.canonical_peak_lr: PROPOSED = pilot value; provisional until a longer run confirms (08 §3.4); grid-edge selections recorded
optimization.schedule: linear warmup 100 updates (pilot); canonical proposal: warmup 1 % of updates, cosine to 10 %
optimization.packing: EOS-separated, cross-document attention allowed, all positions trained (recorded policy)

execution_profile.reference_profile: eager BF16 (core shape, 28K-vocab real-data prefix: 56.2K tokens/s)
execution_profile.optimized_profile: torch.compile default (same basis: 114.4K tokens/s); EXPERIMENTAL, no owner-approved promotion threshold
execution_profile.qualification: two A100 hosts: CUDA/SDPA/test suite; recovery suite 8/8 on host 1 (real data, bitwise; 7 passed first time, T9 failed closed, fixed in cb2a74d, rerun PASS); exact continuation + SIGKILL bitwise (host 2)

proposed_launch_budget.overhead_basis: assumption; arch pilot runs spent ~21 % of wall time outside training (short runs, frequent eval)
proposed_launch_budget.uncertainty: throughput measured over one 183M-token epoch (v5 prefix) on one host; ±10 % assumed for host variance
proposed_launch_budget.profile: torch.compile (the measured rate above comes from compiled runs; EXPERIMENTAL profile)

eager_reference_fallback.ratio_basis: core shape on the 28K-vocab prefix (profile runs), applied to the proposed 24K shards

proposed_launch_budget.note: separate from the $40 preparation authorization; requires owner approval
proposed_launch_budget.stop_conditions: non-finite loss/grad; loss spike > 1.5x running min after warmup; checkpoint or replica failure; budget soft limit; controller idle/deadline

checkpointing.cadence: init; earlier of 500 updates or 15 active minutes; stage boundaries; planned stops; best eval
checkpointing.retention: v0.7 §6 (latest 3, hourly for 24 active h, daily, stage, best, release lineage)
checkpointing.primary_replica: OPEN: HF private primary + Drive replica qualified for size/latency

evaluation.validation: full validation split, 2,583 docs, bits per byte by source

owner_decisions_required: freeze tokenizer j1tok-24k (or order more seeds)
approve successor corpus j1-base-v0.2.1 and one-epoch exposure
approve optimized (compiled) profile or the eager reference
approve canonical launch budget and stop conditions
evaluation thresholds; release rights; Drive key custody; checkpoint primary/replica
